changeSet.author: amp-agent
changeSet.comment: Create default tenant and populate existing data
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO utm_tenant (id, name, subdomain, status, tier, created_at, updated_at, settings, resource_limits) VALUES ( 'default-tenant-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID, 'Default Tenant', 'default', 'active', 'enterprise', NOW(), NOW(), '{"legacy_migration": true, "auto_provisioned": true}', '{"max_users": 1000, "max_dashboards": 100, "max_alerts_per_day": 100000}' ) ON CONFLICT (subdomain) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO utm_tenant_config (tenant_id, config_key, config_value, config_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('default-tenant-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID, 'timezone', 'UTC', 'STRING', NOW(), NOW()), ('default-tenant-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID, 'date_format', 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'STRING', NOW(), NOW()), ('default-tenant-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID, 'max_retention_days', '365', 'INTEGER', NOW(), NOW()), ('default-tenant-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID, 'enable_sso', 'false', 'BOOLEAN', NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, config_key) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO utm_tenant_role (tenant_id, role_name, permissions, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('default-tenant-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID, 'TENANT_ADMIN', '["USER_MANAGEMENT", "DASHBOARD_MANAGEMENT", "ALERT_MANAGEMENT", "CONFIGURATION", "REPORTS"]'::JSONB, NOW(), NOW()), ('default-tenant-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID, 'TENANT_USER', '["DASHBOARD_VIEW", "ALERT_VIEW", "REPORTS_VIEW"]'::JSONB, NOW(), NOW()), ('default-tenant-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID, 'ANALYST', '["DASHBOARD_VIEW", "DASHBOARD_CREATE", "ALERT_MANAGEMENT", "INCIDENT_MANAGEMENT"]'::JSONB, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, role_name) DO NOTHING;
